# Procedures and Outputs

*This chapter will cover:*

- The `Procedure { ... }` declaration syntax
- Defining typed inputs with `input = {}`
- Defining typed outputs with `output = {}`
- The `field` helper functions (field.string, field.number, field.boolean, etc.)
- Returning results from procedures
- Input validation and defaults
- Embedding `Specifications` and running `tactus test`
- Using `Mocks {}` for deterministic tests (`tactus test --mock`)
- Measuring reliability early (`tactus test --runs N`)

*Example procedures:* `code/chapter-05/02-basics-simple-logic.tac`, `code/chapter-05/70-mocking-static.tac`
